Infrastructure Finance Forum: Asia 2026
 
 Be part of IFF: Asia 2026 on 10 & 11 November in Singapore for two days focused on how infrastructure deals are getting done - bringing together developers, sponsors and fund managers to explore investment strategies, capital allocation, fundraising, transaction structuring, financing, partnerships, negotiations and execution.
 
Gain fresh perspectives on the forces shaping infrastructure investment across Asia, from how developers are advancing ambitious project pipelines and securing capital to how fund managers are identifying opportunities, deploying capital and structuring investments for long-term value.

 

View the agenda and list of speakers here >>

Register Now
Sessions in the Spotlight:
 Is this Asia’s Infrastructure “Moment”?     
Explore whether Asia’s infrastructure boom can live up to its promise as abundant capital and growing demand collide with execution risk, regulatory fragmentation, FX volatility and project delays.
 
 ASEAN Integration: Finally, Has the Time Come?  

 Discover what it will take to turn decades of ambition around the ASEAN grid into tangible investment opportunities, addressing regulatory alignment, domestic capital controls, FX risk and the role of multilateral institutions in advancing cross-border projects.

 

How Welcome are Innovative Capital Structures in Asia?

 Unpack the growing role of alternative capital structures in Asian infrastructure and whether they can move from bespoke solutions to a mainstream source of funding. The discussion will address bankability, currency mismatch, refinancing, liquidity and the role of concessional and DFI capital.
